import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int[] a = new int[n];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        int mid = n / 2;
        List<Integer> leftSums = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> rightSums = new ArrayList<>();

        computeLeft(a, 0, 0, mid, m, leftSums);
        computeRight(a, mid, 0, n, m, rightSums);

        Set<Integer> leftSet = new HashSet<>(leftSums);
        List<Integer> uniqueLeftSums = new ArrayList<>(leftSet);
        Collections.sort(uniqueLeftSums);

        int best = 0;

        for (int val : rightSums) {
            int target = m - val;
            int pos = Collections.binarySearch(uniqueLeftSums, target);
            if (pos < 0) {
                pos = -pos - 1;
            }
            if (pos > 0) {
                int candidate = uniqueLeftSums.get(pos - 1) + val;
                if (candidate > best) {
                    best = candidate;
                }
            } else {
                if (val > best) {
                    best = val;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(best);
    }

    private static void computeLeft(int[] a, int index, int currentSum, int mid, int m, List<Integer> leftSums) {
        if (index == mid) {
            leftSums.add(currentSum);
        } else {
            computeLeft(a, index + 1, (currentSum + a[index]) % m, mid, m, leftSums);
            computeLeft(a, index + 1, currentSum, mid, m, leftSums);
        }
    }

    private static void computeRight(int[] a, int index, int currentSum, int n, int m, List<Integer> rightSums) {
        if (index == n) {
            rightSums.add(currentSum);
        } else {
            computeRight(a, index + 1, (currentSum + a[index]) % m, n, m, rightSums);
            computeRight(a, index + 1, currentSum, n, m, rightSums);
        }
    }
}
